fields.label: Path
fields.description: Relative to the Base URL. May carry {site}, and for a Path lookup {<key field>} where the key goes.

fields.label: Lookup
fields.description: Path: GET <path>/<id>. Query: GET <path>?<key>=<value>. OData: $filter=<key> eq '<value>'. JSON Filter: ?filter={"<key>":"<value>"}.

fields.label: Key Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated, in the order used in External ID (values joined by |).

fields.label: Label Field
fields.description: Dotted path to the text shown for the record.

fields.label: Extra Query
fields.description: Fixed query parameters, name=value pairs joined by &; values may carry {site}.
